### What to Look For in an Estate Planning Lawyer

- **Testamentary Trust Expertise:** Drafting a testamentary trust requires deep knowledge of tax laws, asset protection (against future family law breakdowns or creditor risks), and multi-generational control. Ensure the firm explicitly lists trust structuring in their portfolio.[[1]](https://www.awbrisbanelawyers.com.au/wills-and-estates/)
- **Queensland EPOA Compliance:** Powers of attorney in Queensland must strictly adhere to the *Guardianship and Administration Act 2000* and the *Powers of Attorney Act 1998* . Experienced local practitioners prevent costly administrative or validity errors.[[1]](https://www.awbrisbanelawyers.com.au/wills-and-estates/)
- **Holistic Approach:** A good estate lawyer will not just draft a basic will; they will advise you on superannuation-binding death nominations, jointly held assets, and business succession if you own a company or family trust.[[1]](https://www.awbrisbanelawyers.com.au/wills-and-estates/)
